data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French 'al' (ruler) and 'ens' (people). Alenson is a name of noble and regal origins, evoking images of strong leadership and protection. The name Alenson carries the meaning “Ruler of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alenson usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Alenson belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alenson total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
